Bank of America
Interview Experience
Bhoomika Sudarshan Boddireddy
Computer Engineering

Details :
Eligible branches : CE, IT and Circuit branches
CPI Criteria : No CPI criteria
Stipend : Rs 1,41,000 per month
Process :
●Resume Screening
●HireVue Interview
●Offline In-person interview
1. Group Discussion
2. Personal Interview 1
3. Personal Interview 2
Role :
●Global Markets Technology (Coding Based)
●Global Banking Technology (Project Management)
Note: Not necessary that you will get only the role you apply for, if you
want only a specific role you should mention it in the interview
1

Resume Screening
Online Pre-placement talk was conducted on 8th November,2023.
After this our data was collected which had our Resumes and had to
mention the roles we wanted to opt for.
On 17th November, the shortlisted candidates list for HireVue was released (
71- Global Markets and 37- Global Banking candidates were selected)
PS:
It is very important that your Resumes look attractive. Describe your projects
well. Include other activities that you have done like being part of various
committees. Try to mention all your strengths. Do not lie in your resume.
HireVue Interview
For each video question we got 30 sec preparation time and 3 min
answering time.
The questions were :
1. Introduce yourself and why you applied
2. What is your key accomplishment
3. Coding question for 30 min
4. Coding question in 45 min
5. Describe logic of question 4.
Coding questions were of an easy-moderate level
On 24th November, shortlisted candidates list for offline interview was
released ( 25 - Global Markets and 20- Global Banking candidates were
selected)
2

Offline In-person Interview
These interviews were scheduled on 28th Nov 2023 at 9:30 am. We had to
carry 6 resumes.
There were 6 panelists.
1. Group Discussion
This was conducted in the TPO seminar hall. All 6 panelists were present.
We were divided into groups of 11-12. I was in Group 4 and the topic given to
my group was ‘Online vs Offline mode of working’.
You can always start the discussion if you are aware of the topic. Even if you
don't get to start, it's completely alright (I did not get it either). Make sure you
let the panelists know about your opinion. Do not interrupt others while they
are speaking. Remain calm and avoid seeming hasty. If the panelists felt that
some candidates did not get a chance to speak, they specifically asked
them to share their thoughts. Additionally, at the end, they asked two
particular candidates to conclude the group discussion as they had less
chance to speak.
11 candidates of Global Banking and 14 candidates of Global Markets were
selected for the 1st round of interview.
2. Personal Interview 1
There were two panelists for each candidate.
Firstly I was asked to introduce myself. Keep your introduction crisp but
mention the skills essential for the role.
Then I was asked, other than coding, what other extra-curricular activities I
do.
3

In between I mentioned that I was learning Korean so they asked me why
specifically Korean.
I am the TPO CR of the computer engineering branch so they asked me if a
candidate is continuously failing in his/her interview then how will I motivate
that candidate.
I had CPI above 9 so they asked me if I want to pursue masters in future.
Then they asked me what are the difficulties that girls face , why I wanted to
join a bank and why Bank of America and not any other bank.
Then they asked me if I had any questions. Always ask a question, be
prepared for the question beforehand. I asked a question regarding the
roles that I could get in Global Markets which were mentioned in the JD.
They were impressed because I tried to understand those roles.
Overall they were mostly personal response type questions and I was not
asked any technical questions.
Always stay confident while answering and try to answer honestly. Be
prepared for general questions.
9 candidates were shortlisted for the final interview round.
3. Personal Interview 2
In this round all the 6 panelists were going to interview us.
I was the first candidate for this round, so I was a little nervous.
4

The senior most member amongst the panelists tried to make me feel
comfortable. He asked if my friends address me as Bhoomika or Bhoomi to
which I replied Bhoomi. From then onwards while interacting all the
panelists addressed me as Bhoomi. He told me that this round was to know
more about me. They first asked me to introduce myself in 60sec and then
asked about my family members, further studies, any banking background,
location, etc. Then they asked me if I had any doubts.
This was overall more like a conversation. Again try to be honest and
confident.
I was very nervous until the other 8 candidate interviews were going on.
Results :
4 out of 9 candidates received internship offers (2 for each role). I was
fortunate enough to be one of them.
PS :
I was not asked any technical questions but few candidates were asked so
be prepared for it as well. Few candidates were also asked about the
meaning of a few terms like equity,etc so try to prepare for it as well. Stay
confident and be honest. Show them you are a worthy candidate.
Also do not get disheartened if you don't get selected in any interview. I had
not cleared coding rounds of many, given interviews of Citi Bank and Hilti
(even reached the final round). Just wait for your day. Don't lose hope and
keep practicing.
ALL THE BEST !
5
